description.value: Valoroso Foods is an Italian-style deli located on Pacific Boulevard in Vancouver's Yaletown area, near the seawall. The shop is wheelchair accessible and accepts both credit and debit cards, making it a convenient stop for cyclists riding the False Creek route.
